name: identity_grant_restrictions
description: Data restrictions of a Person's explicit grant (ADR-0037): each row admits one value of one dimension. Values of a dimension are alternatives; every restricted dimension of the grant must match. A grant without rows admits every row of its source.
lifecycle: Replaced together with its grant by owners with recent strong authentication; removed with the grant or the Person. Moved with the grant on consolidation. Audited with value counts.

columns.Meaning: The restricted permission of the grant.
Restriction dimension the permission declares, such as company or store; enforced by the module that owns the data.
ERP record code admitted for the dimension (for example CODEMP or loja.id), validated against the source when saved.
Display label read from the ERP when saved (company, project, seller, buyer, store or classification name); may be a person's name. Never typed by the browser.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_id, permission) REFERENCES identity_capability_grants(person_id, permission) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: Restriction belongs to its grant and is removed with it.
A value is admitted once per dimension of a grant.
